lede: Memphis carries the stronger underlying team rating — -2.5 against -13.2, a 10.6-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Charlotte +17.8 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Memphis winning 88% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is pass offense, where Memphis leads Charlotte by 105 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 78% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
